liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Viola Lee Blues** (1 review): The twenty-one-minute performance is described as pure energy [5]
- **Turn On Your Love Light** (1 review): Bobby's last verse is considered the best he ever performed on the song [14]

## The recordings

- **gd68-03-03.aud.vernon.9374.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 6 songs; 59 min; rated 4.47/5 by 32 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is poor, but the band is really on fire; Speed change in the song was addressed during the mastering process [1][11]
- **gd68-03-03.aud.jools.19904.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 5 songs; 59 min; rated 3.67/5 by 15 [2]. Said about its sound: Background noise includes a man blowing a whistle, creating a manic feel [9]
- **gd1968-03-03.aud.finney.5809.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 4 songs; 54 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [3]

## Around the show

- The show was completely impromptu, famously known as the "Flatbed Truck" performance [5]
- The band drove a flatbed truck into the middle of Haight Street [6]
- The crowd went nuts the entire time during the performance [10]
- City shut down Haight Street after a riot; band set up without permits [12]
- Commune members from the "Good Earth" helped set up the equipment [13]
- Taper remembers the closer was Dancing In The Streets [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd68-03-03.aud.vernon.9374.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Brown; transferred by Lance Michel, Raoul Duke, and Matt Vernon; source: Audience [1]. Also: Steve Brown taped it using an old Uher and cheap microphone [6]
- **gd68-03-03.aud.jools.19904.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Julian (Jools) Elliott; source: Audience [2]. Also: Steve Brown traveled from LA to record Cream, then the Dead [8]
- **gd1968-03-03.aud.finney.5809.sbeok.shnf**: source: DHH pre-FM [3]. Also: Master tape incomplete due to low batteries; David Gans played the timed portion [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LUV4MUSIC!: [Spotlight On What I Am Listening To: Grateful Dead - Haight Street, San Francisco, CA 1968-03-03 SBD? - LUV4MUSIC!](https://www.luv4music.org/2026/03/03/spotlight-on-what-i-am-listening-to-grateful-dead-haight-street-san-francisco-ca-1968-03-03-sbd/) [17]
